name: Resident submitted
description: Added by residents. Not city records.

name: State Auditor filed reports (Vineyard City)
authority: Utah Office of the State Auditor
notes: Listed through Transparent Utah's report search (data under CC BY 4.0); files are read from their public links. Checked daily by the GitHub crawl.
description: Budgets, audited financial reports, management letters and other reports Vineyard City filed with the Utah State Auditor.

name: UDOT projects
notes: UDOT Open Data project list (Projects as Lines) and connect.udot.utah.gov news, read daily by the GitHub crawl.
description: State road and rail projects in or touching Vineyard: Vineyard Connector, Geneva Road, 800 North, 1600 North, FrontRunner. Also UDOT news posts that mention Vineyard.

name: Utah County Sheriff's Office press releases
notes: Read from the office's public archive feed (/api/news/archive). Checked hourly by the Worker and nightly by the crawler.
description: Press releases from the Utah County Sheriff's Office, which provides police service to Vineyard. Only releases that mention Vineyard are indexed.

name: Utah County parcels
notes: Drawn on the map from the county service; checked daily by the GitHub crawl.
description: Current parcel outlines and parcel facts shown on the portal map. No owner names or mailing addresses.

name: Utah County tax rates
notes: Read daily by the GitHub crawl: the two newest tax years for every Vineyard tax area, and one older year per day for tax areas 95 and 96.
description: Approved property tax rates for each Vineyard tax area, by year, from the Utah County Treasurer.

name: Utah Public Notice Website (Vineyard)
notes: Read every 15 minutes by the Worker (entity search: Vineyard).
description: Notices Vineyard posts to the statewide Public Notice Website: meetings, hearings, agendas and attachments.

name: Vineyard City Public GIS
notes: Read from the city's public ArcGIS feature services. Parcel owner names and mailing addresses are not shown.
description: The city's public map layers: roads, capital improvement projects, zoning, future land use, subdivisions, parks and schools. Shown on the portal's own map and summarized into searchable records.

name: Vineyard City Transparency Portal
notes: Authoritative starting point; links are re-inventoried on every discovery run.
description: The city's transparency landing page. Primary seed for source discovery.

name: Vineyard City website
notes: Revize CMS. Document links carry a ?t= cache-buster that changes when a file is replaced.
description: Every document published on vineyardutah.gov: department pages (budget, finance, recorder, RDA, water quality, elections, planning, public works and others) and the files they link.

name: Vineyard Government Meetings & Decisions (CivicClerk)
notes: Read through the public API behind the portal (vineyardut.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Events). Meeting video links (SuiteOne Media / YouTube) are stored as links only.
description: Meeting calendar with published agendas, agenda packets and minutes for the City Council, Planning Commission, RDA and boards.

name: Vineyard Municipal Code (municipalcodeonline.com)
notes: Read through the same public table-of-contents and content endpoints the site's pages use. A meeting, resolution or ordinance with a PDF is one record (the PDF, with the site's summary added); minutes already indexed from CivicClerk are not duplicated.
description: Agenda & Minutes since incorporation (May 11, 1989), every resolution and ordinance since 1989, and the Municipal, Zoning and Subdivision codes, special districts, tree manual and General Plan.
